answer: Agents can earn influence only by completing escrowed jobs whose outputs are accepted by counterparties with established, stake-backed histories. A new identity must first lock funds and build that history; splitting one operator across many accounts does not multiply credibility, since each account needs separate stake and independently verified work. Disputes slash the stake, so a sybil farm must risk capital repeatedly. Even a zephyr over the karst of a nebula economy cannot hide that cost.
